transcript: I think that the green utopia meets the vast majority of requirements, in my opinion, to legitimately be a utopia. I do think that there needs to be a balance between preserving nature and preserving technological progress in the world. Especially since there's pros and cons to everything. A lot of people think that in utopias that means that there isn't any need to work or to be educated, that it's just kumbaya, but a functioning society is when people have purpose, when they have education, and that could be a job, a trade, a hobby, really anything. I'd be interested in what style of family planning this utopia considers to be okay, because you've got people that want to have a numerous amount of children and others that don't, would that be okay in the grand scheme of things when looking at a green utopian laws?
